All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) — unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed current production version v2.3.1 was unhealthy; deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 both healthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0" documenting the failure, the rollback, and the target version. The incident was confirmed by a human operator.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Note:** The unhealthy v2.3.1 release should be investigated before any future redeploy attempt.
